reasoning: Since this is the only round, I need to fix the failure at the first arrival step where visits_done stayed at 0 and the policy pointed at the right target anyway. I'll draft edits so the subgoal instruction computes memory first, then prioritizes pointing at the non-highlighted target, and I'll tighten the annotator prompt's wording around identifying the step where the cube is held above its destination.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Every episode starts with subgoal A. At each decision step FIRST update visits_done from what the step shows (per the memory instruction), THEN apply every rule below to the UPDATED value, never the carried-in one. Rules (apply whichever matches the current step and memory):

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: choose B, move to the top of the target. If visits_done is even (0, 2, 4...), point at the right-side target (smaller x); if visits_done is odd (1, 3, 5...), point at the left-side target (larger x). Equivalently, point at the target that is NOT currently highlighted. Use that target's listed coordinates.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: choose B, move to the top of the target. Pointing rule: if a highlighted target is visible in the scene, point at the target that is NOT highlighted (its listed coordinates); the highlighted one is the target just reached and is never the point. If no target is highlighted (just after pick-up), point at the right-side target (smaller x). As a check only, the updated visits_done parity should agree: even (0, 2, 4...) means the point is the right-side target, odd (1, 3, 5...) the left-side target.

edits.modify_from: Add 1 if and only if, at the scene of this decision step, the cube is 'held in the gripper' AND a 'highlighted target' is shown under/near the gripper AND that highlighted target either was absent or was a different target in the first execution frame shown for this step.
edits.modify_to: Compute this field BEFORE choosing the subgoal; the subgoal rules read the updated value. Add 1 if and only if, at the scene of this decision step, the cube is 'held in the gripper' AND a 'highlighted target' is listed under/near the gripper AND, in the first execution frame shown for this step, that same position was listed only as a plain 'target' or no highlighted target was listed at all. The typical first case: the earlier frames of the step list only plain targets and the final scene lists one highlighted target under the held cube; that is an increment, 0 becomes 1. If the highlighted target in the final scene is the same one that was already highlighted in the first frame, do not add.

edits.modify_from: i.e. the step whose final frame shows the cube held in the gripper above a highlighted target that was not highlighted at the first execution frame of that step.
edits.modify_to: i.e. every decision step whose final scene shows the cube held in the gripper with a highlighted target directly below the gripper (same x region), when that target was shown as a plain, un-highlighted target in the first execution frame of the step, or when no highlighted target was shown at all in that first frame. Plain targets only early in the step and a highlighted target at the end is itself the arrival. The first such step takes it from 0 to 1.
